name: Klat AI
desc: Smart AI assistant for coding, image generation, and general Q&A. Supports multiple AI models, code completion, debugging help, creative image generation with prompts, and intelligent answers to any question. Free and unlimited.
desc_id: Asisten AI cerdas untuk coding, pembuatan gambar, dan tanya jawab umum. Mendukung multi-model AI, code completion, bantuan debugging, generasi gambar kreatif dengan prompt, dan jawaban pintar untuk pertanyaan apapun. Gratis dan tanpa batas.

name: Klat Tube
desc: YouTube client for watching videos without ads. Features: ad-free playback, background play, picture-in-picture, download videos/audio, subscription management without account, sponsor block, quality selector, dark mode, no tracking. Free on Windows & Linux.
desc_id: Klien YouTube untuk menonton video tanpa iklan. Fitur: putar tanpa iklan, background play, picture-in-picture, unduh video/audio, kelola langganan tanpa akun, sponsor block, pemilih kualitas, dark mode, tanpa tracking. Gratis di Windows & Linux.

name: Klat OS
desc: A modern operating system built on JowoKernel — a 64-bit monolithic kernel developed entirely from scratch. Built for performance, stability, and POSIX compatibility..
desc_id: Sistem operasi modern berbasis JowoKernel — kernel monolitik 64-bit yang dikembangkan sepenuhnya dari nol. Dibangun untuk performa, stabilitas, dan kompatibilitas POSIX..
